definitions.explanation: A position within an ordered ranking or hierarchy. Used for competitions, examinations, search results, and any ordered list.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}の{順位|じゅんい}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
{世界|せかい}ランキングの{順位|じゅんい}を{上|あ}げたい。
examples.english: I want to raise my world ranking position.

examples.japanese: {検索|けんさく}{順位|じゅんい}を{改善|かいぜん}するためにSEO{対策|たいさく}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: We're implementing SEO measures to improve our search ranking.

notes:
A versatile word used whenever things are ranked or ordered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順位|じゅんい}が{上|あ}がる / {下|さ}がる (ranking goes up / down)
- {順位|じゅんい}を{付|つ}ける (to rank / assign order)
- {順位|じゅんい}を{争|あらそ}う (to compete for position)
- {優先|ゆうせん}{順位|じゅんい} (priority order)
- {検索|けんさく}{順位|じゅんい} (search ranking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {順番|じゅんばん} refers to turn order (whose turn is next)
- {順位|じゅんい} refers to competitive ranking (who is higher/lower)
- {位|くらい} / ～{位|い} is a counter for rank ({一位|いちい}, {二位|にい}, etc.)
